mapper.select: select merchant_id, house_creation_enabled, house_member_management_enabled, max_house_count, max_members_per_house, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from merchant_house_policies where merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.update: update merchant_house_policies set house_creation_enabled = #{houseCreationEnabled}, house_member_management_enabled = #{houseMemberManagementEnabled}, max_house_count = #{maxHouseCount}, max_members_per_house = #{maxMembersPerHouse}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId}
